views.name: chunk_view_2
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  T1.year AS year1,
  T2.year AS year2
FROM team AS T1
INNER JOIN team AS T2
  ON T1.year = T2.year
WHERE
  T1.year < T2.year
LIMIT 0
